newsitem.title: JAPAN: Unidux to issue 1.31 mln new shares to Kanematsu.
newsitem.headline: Unidux to issue 1.31 mln new shares to Kanematsu.

text.p: Trading house Unidux Inc said on Wednesday it would issue 1.31 million new shares for 700 yen per share in a third-party allocation to major trading house Kanematsu Corp.
Unidux and Kanematsu had decided to form an equity alliance in order to strengthen their business tie-up, Unidux said in a statement.
"We have agreed on an equity and broad business tie-up in order to cooperate closely in expanding each other's business," Unidux said.
Unidux said it was considering joint sales of electronics-related products with Kanematsu and its affiliates.
Unidux and Kanematsu will discuss the specifics of their business cooperation at a later date, it said.
After the planned share issue, Kanematsu will become the largest shareholder in Unidux, holding a 10 percent stake, it said.
The payment date for the new share issue is set for April 25, Unidux said.
